children.name: [ Child Name ]
children.message: She was the foundation of everything we built as a family. There was never a moment I doubted her love — it was the kind of love that doesn't need words. It lives in the meals she cooked, the prayers she said over us each morning, and the way she held this homestead together.

children.name: [ Child Name ]
children.message: Mama alikuwa nguzo ya familia yetu. Alitufundisha kuomba kabla ya kulala, kutoa kabla ya kupokea, na kushukuru kwa kila kitu. Sauti yake ya kuimba asubuhi bado inalia moyoni mwangu.

grandchildren.name: [ Grandchild Name ]
grandchildren.message: Cucu always had something cooking on the fire and a story ready when you sat beside her. She knew every grandchild's face, every grandchild's name, and exactly what each of us needed to hear. I am still learning from her.

grandchildren.name: [ Grandchild Name ]
grandchildren.message: Cucu yaari omonto owe naigua sente. Nigo nkomo yake yaaigua amang'ana, omogeni na enchi yake yose. Tiga nigo twamenyerete amakoro yake — ati obonto bwiye n'obonto bw'abaantu.

greatGrandchildren.name: [ Great-grandchild Name ]
greatGrandchildren.message: I was small but I remember the warmth of her hands and the sound of her voice in the morning. She always called me by a special name. I will carry that name forever.
